sentences: Ven mi corazón te llama is a 1942 Argentine film directed by Manuel Romero.
Quintana Saravia Haydée Mercedes, known as Mercedes Quintana( 1910 – 1996 in Buenos Aires) was an Argentine classical dancer, choreographer, director and actress of stage, screen and television.
She had a prominent stage career in Argentina in the 1930s.
She appeared in films such as" Yo quiero ser bataclana"( 1941)," Ven ...
mi corazón te llama"( 1942) and" Mujeres que bailan"( 1949).
Waking the Dead is a 2000 drama film directed by Keith Gordon and starring Billy Crudup and Jennifer Connelly.
The screenplay by Robert Dillon is based on the 1986 novel of the same name by Scott Spencer.
Ben Palmer is a British film and television director who is known for being the director of" Bo' Selecta" and" The Inbetweeners".
Roy Frumkes is an American independent filmmaker.
Frumkes directed the 1985 documentary" Document of the Dead", a film detailing the production of" Dawn of the Dead".
